name: reviewloop
description: Local ReviewLoop skill and stdio MCP server for requesting, following and reading AI paper reviews.

interface.shortDescription: Request, follow and read local ReviewLoop paper-review jobs.
interface.longDescription: Packages the ReviewLoop skill and a local stdio MCP server. The server reads and updates the local job database. Sending a manuscript stays with the machine supervisor after an explicit approval.
defaultPrompt: What is the status of my ReviewLoop review?
